text:
QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and `__GNUC__` is present. Clang qualifies. MSVC, IAR, and armcc5 do not (`constant_time_impl.h:39-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus the compiler macro `__GNUC__`, in a header (`constant_time_impl.h`) and not by a config entry. That conveys the derived mechanism, though it never says outright that it is not set in mbedtls_config.h.
